translation.name: Kitapm kɛn Raa dɔɔko kiji ute jeege

book.name: Timote kɛn deete
book.title: Maktubm deet deet kɛn Pɔl raaŋin̰ Timote ki

content: Naan jee Raage
Taar kɛn maam mꞋje taaɗn ese se taar kɛn mɛt ki, debm je tɛɗn naan jee Raage se, naabm naan̰ je tɛɗa se naabm jiga aak eyo.
Naɓo debm je tɛɗn naana se, Ꞌtɛɗn debm kɛn ɔk taar ɗim ron̰ ki gɔtɔ, ɔk mɛnda kalaŋ sum
, debm bɔɔb ɔk ron̰a, debm saap tɛɗ naka ute ɗoobin̰a, tɛɗ nakŋ jeege tɔɔmin̰a, debm kɔkŋ mɛrtge, ɔɔ debm jeel dooy jeege.
ꞋTɛɗn debm aay tɔtɔ deel te gɔtin̰ eyo, debm je kɔnd naapa ute jeege eyo, gaŋ Ꞌtɛɗn debm maakin̰ deere ɔɔ debm je taar eyo, debm maakin̰ tama eyo.
Bɛɛki se, Ꞌtɛɗn debm jeel kiŋg ute mɛndin̰a ɔɔ ute gɛnin̰ge ɔɔ gɛnin̰ge kic sookin̰ ɔɔ taarin̰ naan̰ taaɗɗen paac se, naaɗe uunu.
Taa debm jaay jeel kiŋg ute mɛndin̰ te gɛnin̰ge ey se, naan̰ Ꞌtɔɔɗn *eglizn gɛn *Raa se ɔɔ ɗio?

Kɛn naase jaay Ꞌje aki kɔnd nam naan jee Raage num, ɔn̰te Ꞌkɔndki debm utu aal kaal maakin̰ do Isa *al‑Masi ki. Ey num, naan̰ Ꞌmagal ron̰a ɔɔ Raa utu an̰ kɔjn̰ bɔɔrɔ don̰ ki aan gɔɔ kɛn naan̰ ɔjo do *Ɓubm sitange tu se.
Debm kiŋg naan jee Raage se, bɛɛki se, jee kɛn ɗoobm Raa ki ey kic ɓo an̰ kaal maak ki. Kɛn bin ey num, naan̰ kɛnd maakŋ sɔkɔn̰ ki ɔɔ naan̰ kɛnd maakŋ sɛɛ Bubm sitange tu
Jee tɛɗn naabgen daan jee Raage tu
Jee tɛɗn naabgen daan jee Raage tu se, bɛɛki se, naaɗe se kic Ꞌtɛɗn jee jeege aalɗe maak ki, jee taaɗ taarɗege di di eyo, jee aay tɔtɔ dɛn eyo ɔɔ jee je gursn jeege cɛr eyo.
Naaɗe kꞋkaal maakɗe do taar kɛn do dɔkin̰ kꞋjeel mɛtin̰ ey jaay ɓɔrse kꞋjeelga mɛtin̰ se ute maak‑saapm jiga.
Kɛn naase jaay Ꞌje aki tɔnd jee Ꞌtɛɗn naaba daan jee Raage tu se, aak ɔkki naabɗege jaayo ɔɔ kɛn ɔŋki te taar ɗim roɗe ki ey jaay ɓo, Ꞌtɔndɗeki Ꞌtɛɗn naaba daan jee Raage tu.
Mɛndgen Ꞌtɛɗn naaba daan jee Raage tu kic se Ꞌtɛɗn mɛndgen jeege aalɗe maak ki, jꞋɔn̰te tɛɗn mɛnd kɔɔɗn jeege, kꞋbɔɔb jꞋɔk roɗe, ɔɔ do nakge tu paac se jꞋɔn̰ten tujn̰ ɔrmɗe.
Jee tɛɗn naabgen daan jee Raage tu se, Ꞌtɛɗn gaabgen mɛndge kalaŋ kalaŋ sum, ɔɔ jeel dɛjn̰ gɛnɗege ɔɔ jeel kiŋg ute jee maakŋ ɓeeɗege tu.

Jee tɛɗn naabgen daan jee Raage tu se jaay tɛɗ naabgen jiga se, kɔl jeege paac aɗen kaal maak ki. Ɔɔ kɛn baagga dooy jeege do taar Isa *al‑Masi kɛn naaje kꞋjꞋaalki maakjege do ki se kic ɓo, Ꞌtaaɗn ɓeer eyo.
Taar kꞋjeel mɛtin̰ ey se ɓɔrse Raa taaɗjekiga mɛtin̰a
Maam mꞋraaŋi maktubm se taa ɔɔpga baata mꞋsaap mꞋutu mꞋai ɓaa kɔŋɔ,
naɓo kɛn mꞋaan te yɔkɔɗ ey kic ɓo, maktubm se ai taaɗa mɛtn taar kiŋg jee Raage ute naapa. Jee se ɓo *eglizn gɛn Raa zɛɛrɛ. Naaɗe se ɓo jee ɔk taar mɛt ki se tɔɔgɔ aan gɔɔ duliy kɛn gak ɓee tɔɔg se.
*Taar mɛt kɛn kꞋjeelki mɛtin̰ eyo, jaay Raa taaɗjeki mɛtin̰ se kɛn taaɗjeki kiŋg ɗoobm Raa ki ɔɔ jꞋaalki maakjege do ki. Taar se magal dɛn dɛna nam an̰ kɔŋ naaj eyo. Taar ese ɓo kɛn taaɗ ɔɔ:

content.text: *Al‑Masi ɓaaɗo tɛɗ ron̰ tɛɗ debkilimi se,
*Nirl Raa taaɗ jeege tu ɔɔ naan̰ se ɓo debm kɛn tɛɗ nakŋ ute ɗoobin̰a.
Jeege taaɗɗega taarin̰ jeege tun Yaudge eyo.
Jeegen do naaŋ kɛn gɔtn ɓaa se paac aalga maakɗe don̰ ki,
ɔɔ Raa uun ɓaansin̰ maakŋ raa ki ɔɔ *nookin̰ga.

footnotes.text: Gɔtn iin̰ tap ɓo jeel mɛnd se sum.
Kɛn bin se Bubm sitange kɔŋ ɗoobm an̰ tuj saaɗin̰a.
